# toBulletStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`BulletStyleInput`](bullet-style-input.md) to the [`BulletStyle`](bullet-style.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toBulletStyle(input: BulletStyleToken | BulletStyle): BulletStyle
```
